text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to oversee today's
training session,
when...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uuugh. I'm so booored.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like... bored outta my miiiiind.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, crap, how long have you been here?
Talk
about cringe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, it's almost time to train, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But here I am, doomscrolling on my
phone and
playing with my split ends.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's just like... I dunno, I'm not exactly
feeling the
training vibes, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'll do the training and whatever,
but...
Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's got to be something I can say to
her to
boost her motivation...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Only one lap? That's barely
anything!
choice_data_list: Jogging in a different spot than usual

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that a good way to kick-start
her
motivation is simply to begin, even if
it's from
somewhere small.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, so it's like when I've gotta clean
my room.
All right, say less. I'll give it a
go.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And well, if I'm gonna run, I may as well
go super
hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Based on how happy Tosen Jordan looks
running,
it seems she wasn't actually that
averse to training
after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What for? A change of pace or
something?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that doing something different
will
provide the push she needs to break
out of the
rut she's in.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Come to think of it, I was always
hella
stoked when we got to have class
outside in
elementary school.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We were still studying the same ol'
boring stuff,
but it just hit different—like
we were on a mini
field trip.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I see now. It's just like that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll go find somewhere to run.
Thanks for
the pep talk! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Based on how quickly Tosen Jordan goes
off to
run, it seems like all she needed
was a little push.
